caption: The drawing is executed on light beige paper with fine black pencil or ink lines. It features three main objects: on the left side, two hardware pieces are shown, one above the other. The upper piece is labeled "Key Plate" and the lower piece is labeled "Handle." Both items have a decorative, symmetrical design with curves and a finial at the top center. To the right of these hardware drawings is a vertical side view of a piece of furniture, likely a cabinet or wardrobe. The furniture shows a rectangular main body with a projecting top cornice, twisted detailing running vertically along the front corner, a lower section with an arch cut-out, and cabriole legs with curled feet. Each drawing is contained within a faint rectangular border. The lower left corner of the rectangle contains the annotation "[Scale 1/4"=1']," and the bottom right of the rectangle is labeled "Side View." The artist's name, "Sylvia Anderson," appears at the lower right outside the rectangle. The composition is minimal, with no shading or background details, and all lines are clean and precise.
title: Highboy
